english.title: Fail to ensure welfare of animal in premises other than slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person engaged in the movement or lairaging of animals]_

in respect of premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that

(C)_[every animal was unloaded as soon as possible after its arrival]_
(D)_[every animal was protected from adverse weather conditions and was provided with adequate ventilation]_
(E)_[an animal which had been subjected to high temperatures in humid weather was cooled by appropriate means]_
(F)_[pending the killing of a sick or disabled animal it was kept apart from any animal which was not sick or disabled]_
(G)_[no person dragged an animal which had been stunned or killed over any other animal which had not been stunned or killed]_

in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 11 of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
